mapper.sql: C.CMPL_NUMB , C.USER_NUMB , R.USER_NICK AS REPORTER_NICK , C.TAGT_TYPE , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{cmplTagt}, C.TAGT_TYPE, #{cmplTagt}) AS TAGT_TYPE_NAME , C.TAGT_NUMB , T.USER_NICK AS TARGET_USER_NICK , C.CMPL_RSON , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{cmplRson}, C.CMPL_RSON, #{cmplRson}) AS CMPL_RSON_NAME , C.CMPL_CNTN , C.CMPL_STAT , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{cmplStat}, C.CMPL_STAT, #{cmplStat}) AS CMPL_STAT_NAME , C.PROC_CNTN , C.PROC_ADMN , FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(C.PROC_ADMN) AS PROC_ADMN_NAME , C.PROC_DATE , C.REGI_DATE , C.UPDT_DATE

P.CMPL_NUMB , P.USER_NUMB , P.REPORTER_NICK , P.TAGT_TYPE , P.TAGT_TYPE_NAME , P.TAGT_NUMB , P.TARGET_USER_NICK , P.CMPL_RSON , P.CMPL_RSON_NAME , P.CMPL_CNTN , P.CMPL_STAT , P.CMPL_STAT_NAME , P.PROC_CNTN , P.PROC_ADMN , P.PROC_ADMN_NAME , P.PROC_DATE , P.REGI_DATE , P.UPDT_DATE
mapper.select: SELECT /* getComplaintListCount */ COUNT(1) FROM TH_CMPLNT C LEFT JOIN TM_USERXM R ON R.USER_NUMB = C.USER_NUMB WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT /* getComplaintDtl */
, RPF.FILE_PATH AS REPORTER_PROF_PATH , RBF.FILE_PATH AS REPORTER_BGIM_PATH FROM TH_CMPLNT C LEFT JOIN TM_USERXM R ON R.USER_NUMB = C.USER_NUMB LEFT JOIN TM_FILEXM RPF ON RPF.FILE_NUMB = R.PROF_NUMB LEFT JOIN TM_FILEXM RBF ON RBF.FILE_NUMB = R.BGIM_NUMB LEFT JOIN TM_USERXM T ON T.USER_NUMB = C.TAGT_NUMB AND C.TAGT_TYPE = #{cmplUser} WHERE C.CMPL_NUMB = #{cmplNumb}

SELECT /* getComplaintForUpdate */ C.CMPL_NUMB , C.USER_NUMB , C.TAGT_TYPE , C.TAGT_NUMB , C.CMPL_RSON , C.CMPL_CNTN , C.CMPL_STAT , C.PROC_CNTN , C.PROC_ADMN , C.PROC_DATE , C.REGI_DATE , C.UPDT_DATE FROM TH_CMPLNT C WHERE C.CMPL_NUMB = #{cmplNumb} FOR UPDATE
